home.title: Welcome to Taba
home.body: Check-in, donations and the search for people will live here. The app is installed and opens even without signal.
language.label: Language
install.title: Install Taba on your home screen
install.body: So the app can keep your records and work without signal, install it first: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen". Then open Taba from its icon.
persist.warning: Data on this phone may be erased by the browser; sync often.
degraded.banner: Face recognition is unavailable. Registration continues by name and wristband.
notfound.title: Page not found
login.title: Sign in
login.body: You will take a selfie to show you are a real person. We keep a code, not your photo.
login.offline: You need an internet connection to sign in.
login.degraded: Face recognition is unavailable, so signing in is paused. Whoever already signed in on this phone can keep working.
return.timeout: This is taking longer than expected. Try signing in again.
profile.title: Your profile
profile.intro_new: Tell us who you are, so other volunteers recognize you.
profile.name: Name
profile.show_phone: Show my phone to whoever tries to create a shelter near mine
pin.title: Create your PIN
pin.body: 6 digits. You will use it to switch between people on this phone, even without signal.
switch.title: Switch operator
switch.body: Pick who is using the phone now.
switch.empty: Nobody has signed in on this phone yet.
switch.locked: Too many wrong PINs. {name} was signed out on this phone and needs to sign in again.
switch.no_session: That session ended. Sign in again.
error.network: No signal. Try again when you are online.
error.capture_inconclusive: We could not read your face. Try again with more light.
error.capture_failed: We could not read your face. Try again with more light.
error.capture_canceled: The selfie was canceled. You can try again whenever you want.
error.capture_expired: The selfie link expired. Start again.
error.capture_wrong_device: Open the link on the same phone where you started.
error.capture_not_found: We could not find this sign-in. Start again.
error.unico_busy: Many people are signing in right now. Try again in a few seconds.
error.unico_limit: Face recognition is unavailable right now. Try again later.
error.unico_degraded: Face recognition is unavailable right now. Try again later.
error.unico_unavailable: Face recognition is unavailable right now. Try again later.
error.invalid_profile: Check the name and the phone.
switch.no_pin: No PIN was created for {name}. Sign in again to create it.
